# Project Charter — CLL-SPM

Complete this template when your Tier 1 project is approved (the workspace is
provisioned automatically). A charter link is **required before your project can
become Active** — the registry blocks the transition without it.

| Field | Enter |
|---|---|
| Item ID | CLL-YY-NNNN (from the registry / approval) |
| Title | |
| Sponsor | (executive accountable for outcome) |
| Lead | (person accountable for delivery) |
| Lead unit / contributing units | |
| Tier / alignment | (primary priority + objective, or Operational/Compliance with justification) |
| Start date / target end date | |
| Effort estimate (staff hours) / cost estimate | |

## 1. Problem and outcome
What problem does this project solve, and what is different when it's done? 3-5 sentences.

## 2. Scope
In scope:
Out of scope (explicit non-goals):

## 3. Success measures
KPI IDs from the registry this project moves, and how (baseline → target contribution).

## 4. Milestones
Executive-visible milestones (they appear on the Dean overview). Add each to the
Milestones list with baseline and forecast dates.

| Milestone | Baseline date | Forecast date |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## 5. Team and decision rights
Who decides scope changes, who decides budget, who decides schedule. Name people.

## 6. Risks at approval
Top 3-5 risks, each with owner and mitigation. (Maintain the running log below.)
